nodes.name: 0000_smiling_slyde.sql
nodes.summary: Initial PostgreSQL migration defining CMS staff roles, submission statuses and types, attachments, staff users, submission notes, submissions, their foreign keys, and query indexes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PostgreSQL enums, identity primary keys, JSONB payloads, timestamp-with-time-zone audit fields, cascading attachment cleanup, and composite indexes.

nodes.name: attachments
nodes.summary: Stores uploaded submission attachments with ownership, original file metadata, storage path, and creation time.

nodes.name: staff_users
nodes.summary: Stores CMS staff identities, unique email addresses, password hashes, display names, roles, and account creation timestamps.

nodes.name: submission_notes
nodes.summary: Stores staff-authored notes associated with customer submissions and optionally records the staff author.

nodes.name: submissions
nodes.summary: Central CMS work queue for customer requests, storing typed JSON payloads, workflow status, contact details, references, Shopify synchronization state, reviewer audit fields, and timestamps.

nodes.name: 0001_curly_banshee.sql
nodes.summary: Adds a created_by_staff reference to submissions so staff-created records can retain their originating CMS user.

nodes.name: 0002_add_return_request.sql
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the submission_type PostgreSQL enum to add return_request while removing the obsolete trade_account value, converting the submissions column through text during the change.
